## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve confirm-only T0/T1 refutation, conservative abstention, package normalization, registry response mapping, per-manifest fail-open enumeration, and the closed reason vocabulary. Preserve detector applicability, backend responsibility, normalized evidence, custom-language config, fail-open execution, and public oracle result/coverage shapes across refute_absence, applies, scan, and contract. Preserve reference validation, ctags index reuse, member/import/file routing, environment fallback, schema compatibility, and deterministic import extraction. Preserve Terraform corroborator snapshot isolation, relative position filenames, positive-only evidence, and fail-closed abstention. The three YAML files are executable detector descriptors: only their leading comment/blank-line regions may change; every non-comment, non-blank YAML line, matcher, citation, severity, backend, dimension, and exclusion remains byte-identical. Consumers are the code-review grounding workflow, detector registry/engines, library oracle, and their tests.

Concise or load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do every runtime string, assertion, fixture, decorator, command argument, config key/value, and physical directive/shebang line. Repository-wide __doc__/inspect.getdoc census found no programmatic consumer of an allowlisted docstring. For YAML, the oracle separately requires the ordered non-comment/non-blank line sequence to be byte-identical.

## Verification and independent review
Compare each final file to d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. For Python, parse with type_comments=True, replace only leading docstrings owned by the allowlisted Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef owners, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. A zero-context diff-hunk guard permits changes only inside the cited base spans; directive/shebang physical lines must match exactly. Run the structured focused, path, hygiene, diff, and untimed repository commands.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with one PASS row per edited block (53 total): stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every final_words value must be smaller; missing, extra, or FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 53 allowlisted blocks are shortened; no other prose or directive changes.
- [ ] The immutable-base prose-only oracle passes for all 8 files.
- [ ] Every preserved contract above has a concrete independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the declared paths; focused checks, diff-check, hygiene, and make verify exit 0.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 53 complete PASS rows and proves a word-count reduction per block.
